completion.title: Complete your freelancer profile
completion.description: Add your skills, hourly rate, portfolio, and work preferences so clients can better understand your experience and offer you relevant projects.
completion.label: Profile completion:
completion.hint: Profiles with portfolios and skills get more relevant project offers.

portfolioModal.title: Portfolio
portfolioModal.tagsHint: Up to 5 tags separated by commas
portfolioModal.currentImage: The current image stays unless you choose a new one.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Add the skills that best describe your services and experience. These skills help clients find your profile and understand what kind of projects you can work on.
skills.placeholder: Type a skill, for example: Figma, Web Design, SEO, Copywriting
skills.label: Search or add skills
skills.hint: Choose up to {{max}} skills that best match your services.
skills.limit: You can add up to {{max}} skills

hourlyRate.title: Hourly rate
hourlyRate.description: Set the hourly rate you want clients to see on your profile. You can change it later depending on your experience, project type, or availability.
hourlyRate.standardDesc: This rate will be shown on your public profile.
hourlyRate.projectDesc: We partner with clients on specific tasks
hourlyRate.coverLetterPlaceholder: Tell us more about your experience...
hourlyRate.rateHint: Enter the amount you want to charge per hour.
hourlyRate.fromDesc: Clients will see “from ${{rate}} / hour” on your profile.
hourlyRate.notePlaceholder: For example: Final price may depend on project scope and timeline.
hourlyRate.tipText: Choose a rate that reflects your experience, skill level, and the value you provide. You can update your rate anytime.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.addProjectDesc: Showcase your best work to clients.

workPreferences.title: Work preferences
workPreferences.description: Tell clients what type of projects you are open to and how you prefer to work.

proBanner.title: Make your profile stand out
proBanner.description: Add a cover image, customize your profile, and unlock more opportunities with Pro.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.description: Track your progress, completed projects, reviews, and profile milestones.

store.title: Store
store.description: Buy profile boosts, visual upgrades, badges, and other platform features.

advertising.title: Advertising
advertising.description: Promote your services, profile, or project to reach more clients.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your information, password, notifications, privacy, and more.

affiliate.title: Affiliate program
affiliate.description: Invite new users to WorkZora and earn rewards for successful referrals.

bonuses.title: Bonuses
bonuses.description: View your bonus balance, promo codes, and available offers.

portfolioSection.title: Portfolio
portfolioSection.addText: Show your best work to help clients understand your style, experience, and the type of results you can deliver.
portfolioSection.deleteConfirm: Delete this project from your portfolio?

kyc.title: Identity verification

text.not_verified: Verify your identity to withdraw money and get the verified badge on your profile.
text.in_progress: Your documents were sent. We will check them and update the status.
text.verified: Your identity is confirmed. You can withdraw money from your balance.

kyc.hint: Photos must be clear and the document fully visible. Data is used only for verification.
kyc.fileError: Choose an image up to 10 Mb

password.title: Password
password.text: To change the password we will send a code to your email.
